problem_type: Polling starts an outbound read after its shared deadline
symptom: Shared submit-plus-wait budget fixture does not return at forty seconds.
direct_cause: Polling checks time before sleeping but starts fetch after sleep even when no time remains.
class_root: The shared polling boundary admits an outbound attempt without a positive remaining budget.
affected_population: Onboarding wait after a slow submit
Any nonterminal poll where interval reaches remaining budget
internal_only_reason: Node child lifecycle and Nomi bounded-owner implementation are directly reproduced with real local fixture children; no inference or external behavior is involved.
invariants: No new fetch begins when the shared wait budget has expired.
Timeout retains accepted task identity and never submits again.

door_reduction.why_not: Existing model onboarding consumers share the polling owner.

generality_proof: A shared post-sleep admission check applies across every interval and provider without extending deadlines.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Admit each fetch against the remaining wait budget after sleep.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Thirty-second submit shares the same forty-second tool budget.
Interval longer than or equal to remaining budget is covered by direct fake-clock tests.

recurrence.reason: Any final sleep can exhaust the remaining budget.
same_class_scan: Inspected all shared wait consumers and tryModelSubmitBudget fixture
Refreshed generated door map after whole-owner extraction: pollTaskToTerminal, sleep

prevention.invariant: Positive remaining budget is required before each fetch.
prevention.failure_mode: Return timeout with the unchanged nonterminal task; never retry generation.
prevention.strategy: Check the same absolute elapsed deadline after sleep before invoking fetch.

legacy_paths.rationale: The expired-budget fetch is removed from the existing owner.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency upgrade; reuse existing shared publication contract.

migration: No persisted state or settings change.
residual_risks: No real provider submit is performed.
